_about: The single registry of documented vPIC defects ultravin deliberately does not reproduce. Every entry is re-probed against the new oracle on every data refresh (scripts/parity/known_problems.py + the known-problems gate); an entry that stops reproducing is stale and fails the refresh. Evidence for each `class` lives in the docs/KNOWN_DEVIATIONS.md section its `doc` anchor names. One class is enumerated by machine instead of by VIN — the stale vpic.wmiyearvalidchars cells in scripts/stale_cache_cells.json, adjudicated by scripts/parity/stale_cache.py — and only its clean-decode members appear here. Policy: docs/ACCEPTANCE.md.

entries.cause: vpic.fvalidcharsinregex compiles the pattern key `*****|*[1-A-JT]` (vinschema 24522, BRINKLEY RV trailers, WMI 7T0 MY2023-2025) as a Postgres regex; Postgres rejects that character class, so spvindecode raises and returns no rows at all.
entries.evidence: pattern rows 1827685/1827686 carry keys='*****|*[1-A-JT]'; `select '1' ~ '^[1-A-JT]$'` errors on the oracle, while vpic.sqlwild_to_regex patches that exact key with REPLACE(out,'1-A','1A') — the dump's two compile sites contradict each other.
